import zipfile, collections, statistics
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, rankdata

zs=[('animals','inputs/scogs_animals.zip'),('fungi','inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')]
results={}
for label,path in zs:
    vals=[]; vals_gapstate=[]; lens=[]; nseqs=[]; bad=[]; alph=collections.Counter()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        members=sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft'))
        for n in members:
            text=z.read(n).decode()
            seqs=[]; cur=[]
            for line in text.splitlines():
                if line.startswith('>'):
                    if cur: seqs.append(''.join(cur)); cur=[]
                else: cur.append(line.strip().upper())
            if cur: seqs.append(''.join(cur))
            nseqs.append(len(seqs))
            if not seqs or len(set(map(len,seqs))) "'!= 1:
                bad.append(n); continue
            L=len(seqs[0]); lens.append(L)
            pi=0; pig=0
            for col in zip(*seqs):
                alph.update(col)
                c=collections.Counter(x for x in col if x not in '"'-.?X*')
                if sum(v>=2 for v in c.values()) >= 2: pi+=1
                cg=collections.Counter(col)
                if sum(v>=2 for v in cg.values()) >= 2: pig+=1
            vals.append(pi); vals_gapstate.append(pig)
    results[label]=vals
    print(label,'members',len(members),'processed',len(vals),'bad',len(bad),'nseq distribution',collections.Counter(nseqs))
    print('length min median max',min(lens),statistics.median(lens),max(lens))
    print('PI ignore missing/gap min median mean max',min(vals),statistics.median(vals),statistics.mean(vals),max(vals),'sum',sum(vals))
    print('PI gap-state min median mean max',min(vals_gapstate),statistics.median(vals_gapstate),statistics.mean(vals_gapstate),max(vals_gapstate),'sum',sum(vals_gapstate))
    print('alphabet',dict(alph))

x,y=results['animals'],results['fungi']
for method in ['auto','asymptotic','exact']:
    z=mannwhitneyu(x,y,alternative='two-sided',method=method)
    print('scipy',method,'U animals-first',z.statistic,'p',z.pvalue)
# manual rank U and tie counts
allv=x+y
r=rankdata(allv,method='average')
u1=sum(r[:len(x)])-len(x)*(len(x)+1)/2
u2=len(x)*len(y)-u1
print('manual U1 U2 min',u1,u2,min(u1,u2),'n1*n2',len(x)*len(y),'distinct',len(set(allv)),'tie groups',sum(v>1 for v in collections.Counter(allv).values()))

import zipfile, collections, statistics

zs=[('animals','inputs/scogs_animals.zip'),('fungi','inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')]
results={}; results_gap={}
for label,path in zs:
    vals=[]; vals_gapstate=[]; lens=[]; nseqs=[]; bad=[]; alph=collections.Counter()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        members=sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft'))
        for n in members:
            text=z.read(n).decode()
            seqs=[]; cur=[]
            for line in text.splitlines():
                if line.startswith('>'):
                    if cur: seqs.append(''.join(cur)); cur=[]
                else: cur.append(line.strip().upper())
            if cur: seqs.append(''.join(cur))
            nseqs.append(len(seqs))
            if not seqs or len(set(map(len,seqs))) "'!= 1:
                bad.append(n); continue
            L=len(seqs[0]); lens.append(L)
            pi=0; pig=0
            for col in zip(*seqs):
                alph.update(col)
                c=collections.Counter(x for x in col if x not in '"'-.?X*')
                if sum(v>=2 for v in c.values()) >= 2: pi+=1
                cg=collections.Counter(col)
                if sum(v>=2 for v in cg.values()) >= 2: pig+=1
            vals.append(pi); vals_gapstate.append(pig)
    results[label]=vals; results_gap[label]=vals_gapstate
    print(label,'members',len(members),'processed',len(vals),'bad',len(bad),'nseq distribution',collections.Counter(nseqs))
    print('length min median max',min(lens),statistics.median(lens),max(lens))
    print('PI ignore missing/gap min median mean max',min(vals),statistics.median(vals),statistics.mean(vals),max(vals),'sum',sum(vals))
    print('PI gap-state min median mean max',min(vals_gapstate),statistics.median(vals_gapstate),statistics.mean(vals_gapstate),max(vals_gapstate),'sum',sum(vals_gapstate))
    print('alphabet',dict(alph))

def mann_u(x,y):
    indexed=sorted((v,i) for i,v in enumerate(x+y))
    ranks=[0.0]*len(indexed)
    p=0
    while p<len(indexed):
        q=p+1
        while q<len(indexed) and indexed[q][0]==indexed[p][0]: q+=1
        avg=(p+1+q)/2
        for _,i in indexed[p:q]: ranks[i]=avg
        p=q
    u1=sum(ranks[:len(x)])-len(x)*(len(x)+1)/2
    return u1,len(x)*len(y)-u1,ranks
for label,d in [('ignore-gap',results),('gap-state',results_gap)]:
    x,y=d['animals'],d['fungi']; u1,u2,r=mann_u(x,y)
    print(label,'U1 animals',u1,'U2 fungi',u2,'min',min(u1,u2),'product',len(x)*len(y),'rank sum animal',sum(r[:len(x)]))
    print('distinct',len(set(x+y)),'tie groups',sum(v>1 for v in collections.Counter(x+y).values()))

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
pi_counts <- function(zipfile) {
  members <- unzip(zipfile, list=TRUE)"'$Name
  members <- sort(members[grepl('"'\\\\.faa\\\\.mafft"'$'"', members)])
  ans <- numeric(length(members))
  for (j in seq_along(members)) {
    con <- unz(zipfile, members[j], open='r')
    lines <- readLines(con, warn=FALSE)
    close(con)
    heads <- which(startsWith(lines, '>'))
    ends <- c(heads[-1] - 1L, length(lines))
    seqs <- vapply(seq_along(heads), function(i) paste0(lines[(heads[i]+1L):ends[i]], collapse=''), character(1))
    mat <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(seqs, '', fixed=TRUE))
    ans[j] <- sum(apply(mat, 2, function(site) {
      tab <- table(site[site "'!= '"'-'])
      sum(tab >= 2L) >= 2L
    }))
  }
  ans
}
a <- pi_counts('inputs/scogs_animals.zip')
f <- pi_counts('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')
cat('n:', length(a), length(f), '\\n')
cat('rank sum animals:', sum(rank(c(a,f))[seq_along(a)]), '\\n')
cat('manual U:', sum(rank(c(a,f))[seq_along(a)]) - length(a)*(length(a)+1)/2, '\\n')
print(wilcox.test(a, f, alternative='two.sided', exact=FALSE, correct=FALSE))
RS"

pi_counts <- function(zipfile) {
  listing <- unzip(zipfile, list=TRUE)
  keep <- grepl('\\\\.faa\\\\.mafft"'$'"', listing"'$Name)
  members <- listing[keep, ]
  members <- members[order(members$Name), ]
  ans <- numeric(nrow(members))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(members))) {
    con <- unz(zipfile, members$Name[j], open='"'rb')
    txt <- rawToChar(readBin(con, what='raw', n=members"'$Length[j]))
    close(con)
    lines <- strsplit(txt, '"'\\n', fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
    lines <- sub('\\r"'$'"', '', lines)
    heads <- which(startsWith(lines, '>'))
    ends <- c(heads[-1] - 1L, length(lines))
    seqs <- vapply(seq_along(heads), function(i) paste0(lines[(heads[i]+1L):ends[i]], collapse=''), character(1))
    mat <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(seqs, '', fixed=TRUE))
    ans[j] <- sum(apply(mat, 2, function(site) {
      tab <- table(site[site "'!= '"'-'])
      sum(tab >= 2L) >= 2L
    }))
  }
  ans
}
a <- pi_counts('inputs/scogs_animals.zip')
f <- pi_counts('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')
r <- rank(c(a,f), ties.method='average')
cat('n:', length(a), length(f), '\\n')
cat('rank sum animals:', sum(r[seq_along(a)]), '\\n')
cat('manual U:', sum(r[seq_along(a)]) - length(a)*(length(a)+1)/2, '\\n')
print(wilcox.test(a, f, alternative='two.sided', exact=FALSE, correct=FALSE))
